VCL_UPDATE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ramzanjunejosahib345-star/Ramzan-n/main/main.lua"
require "import"
import "android.os.*"
import "java.io.*"
import "java.lang.Byte"
import "java.lang.reflect.Array"
import "java.util.zip.Inflater"
local PAYLOAD = {
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
"",
""
}
local function say(t) pcall(function() service.speak(t) end) end
local started = false
local function runMain()
  if started then return end
  started = true
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local data = luajava.bindClass("android.util.Base64").decode(table.concat(PAYLOAD), 0)
    local inf = Inflater()
    inf.setInput(data)
    local baos = ByteArrayOutputStream()
    local buf = Array.newInstance(Byte.TYPE, 65536)
    local guard = 0
    while not inf.finished() and guard < 2000 do
      local n = tonumber(inf.inflate(buf))
      if n > 0 then baos.write(buf, 0, n)
      elseif inf.needsInput() or inf.needsDictionary() then break end
      guard = guard + 1
    end
    pcall(function() inf["end"]() end)
    local code = tostring(baos.toString("UTF-8"))
    local fn, e = load(code, "=voice_cleaner", "t", _ENV)
    if not fn then error("load failed: " .. tostring(e)) end
    local ok2, e2 = pcall(fn)
    if not ok2 then error(tostring(e2)) end
  end)
  if not ok then say("Plugin could not start. " .. tostring(err)) end
end
runMain()
